notes.title: Demo Trailer Live Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5DplrXLiP-k;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Hey there — I’m a solo developer working on Writer Tycoon, a chill writing life simulator where you start out broke in a tiny studio apartment, trying to make it as an author.
In this game, you plan your books, write short creative prompts, edit them with focus choices, and see how well they perform. You’ll level up your writing skills, gain fans, unlock research like marketing and book sequels, and slowly build your career one book at a time.

What’s in the coming demo:
[list]
[*] Plan, write, and edit books across genres like sci-fi, romance, fantasy, and more
[*] Each book is built from short prompts — your creativity matters
[*] Watch reviews roll in and try to hit that elusive 10/10 score
[*] Earn research points to unlock things like better marketing and phase control
[*] Upgrade your setup and customize your little writing space
[*] Write sequels to your best hits and grow your fanbase
[/list]

This trailer shows just a slice of what I’m working on. If you like the vibe, consider wishlisting Writer Tycoon on Steam. It helps a ton and keeps me going.

Thanks for checking it out.

notes.title: Hello! Small showcase for the game
notes.content:
Hello guys. This is a showcase of the game. 
[previewyoutube=L7qTev1jOr4;full][/previewyoutube]


More details about the game: its a writing simulator in which you write books and then you sell them in a journey to become a best-selling author. But you actually get to write. Then a custom algorithm rates your books based on what you wrote and according to the genre you selected, keywords, etc. Of course the game is pretty barebones right now with the content in the video covering most of it, but I will keep working on it.
